chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Meeting at the KP Hall in Charleston; Edgar Hayes and Claude Jones
summary: She was 15 when they met at a dance in Charleston; she knew Edgar Hayes and Claude Jones of McKinney's Cotton Pickers.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You said you met when you were 15?
He was playing there. We had gone to a dance, at the KP hall.

In Charleston, West Virginia, Washington Street. ... And then they used to come and play on the boat there. We had a lot of boats there in those days. That's when I first met Edgar Hayes. I met Edgar Hayes before I met him, 'cause he married my girl friend. They live out in California now. That's where I met Claude Jones... he died.
He played with McKinney's Cotton Pickers, 'cause I knew him too. He married my girl friend.
And he was out of Detroit?
McKinney's Cotton Pickers all were from Detroit...
